# Third-party assets, pinned by hash. The official Repository serves them, and these sources
# are their second source (ADR 0008); a development build fetches them from there.
#   source <name> <url>                              a folder, ending with '/'
#   <source>[:<path>] <installed path> <size> <sha256> [nopick | <group>]
# The file is at <path> under the source, or else at its installed name. nopick: not offered
# in the emoji picker. A group other than shared: only that Skin Pack needs it. To add an
# emoji, add its line; the hash is that of the file at the pinned commit.
source twemoji https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jdecked/twemoji/b6b55fef1e8636b540a6d016a4729ca8cdf2e60b/assets/svg/
source twemoji-root https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jdecked/twemoji/b6b55fef1e8636b540a6d016a4729ca8cdf2e60b/
# By tag, as jsDelivr refused this large repository by commit. The hash still pins it.
source pretendard https://raw.githubusercontent.com/orioncactus/pretendard/v1.3.9/packages/pretendard-gov/dist/public/variable/
source pretendard-root https://raw.githubusercontent.com/orioncactus/pretendard/v1.3.9/
